purpose: Independent adjudication of a T070 pair after the required competent annotations exist. Automation must not populate adjudicator identity, final label, rationale, or disposition.
rules: Adjudication must bind the exact pair bytes and both immutable annotation records.
The adjudicator must not be represented as independent if they generated the candidate pair or supplied either bound annotation.
A machine may validate record completeness but may not invent adjudication fields.
Changing the pair, source bytes, or either annotation digest invalidates this adjudication binding.
